items.titleZh: 墨西哥大奖赛暴露2026规则下的“愚蠢”限速
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥大奖赛暴露出2026年规则中一项被刘易斯·汉密尔顿称为“愚蠢”的限速规定，它让车手在直道末端难以完成超车。
items.originalTitle: The 'stupid' speed limit that neutered Mexican GP explained
items.summaryEn: The Mexican Grand Prix exposed a 2026 regulation speed limit that Lewis Hamilton openly called "stupid", making overtaking at the end of straights difficult for drivers.
detailZh: 一级方程式车手已经习惯了2026年规则带来的诸多怪异之处，但墨西哥大奖赛暴露出了刘易斯·汉密尔顿公开称之为“愚蠢”的一条。
在这条历史上就因为稀薄空气导致空气动力学和冷却方面妥协而极难超车的赛道上，今年的情况更加艰难。
比赛最后几圈凸显出足够的速度差根本不存在：汉密尔顿竭尽全力想借助领先者马克斯·维斯塔潘的尾流在一号弯发起进攻，而更靠后的兰多·诺里斯则打算对夏尔·勒克莱尔做同样的事。
即便有超车模式带来的额外0.5MJ能量，以及发车直道长距离冲刺中的尾流，汉密尔顿和诺里斯都无法贴近到足以完成超车的程度。
阻碍他们的主要因素并不是高海拔场地削弱了尾流效应——在DRS优势对后车已经消失的这一年里，情况并非如此。相反，这是一条鲜为人知的2026年规则带来的后果，该规则实际上让F1在限速下运行。
作为帮助管理能量匮乏赛车在直道上的性能表现的一部分，规则手册对直道末端的能量部署设定了限制。
这本应有助于确保功率（以及因此速度）的补偿，以帮助超车模式，但在墨西哥，它被证明更多是一种阻碍。
为了帮助管理能量部署的使用，没有超车模式的赛车一旦达到某一速度，其能量部署就会受到限制。
这些规则是F1技术规则C5.2.8的一部分，乍看之下施加了一个复杂的公式来限制能量部署。
其中规定，当超车模式未激活时，最大部署功率（上限为350千瓦）在车速低于340公里/小时的情况下，可为1800减去5乘以车速（公里/小时）。
在340公里/小时至345公里/小时之间，最大部署功率可为6900减去20乘以车速（公里/小时），而车速高于345公里/小时时必须为零。
当超车模式激活时，在车速低于355公里/小时的情况下，限制为7100减去20乘以车速（公里/小时），而当车速等于或高于355公里/小时时为零。
听起来很复杂，但正如上方关于最大允许功率的图表所示，这意味着对于没有超车模式的车手，在时速超过290公里后，能量部署必须从350千瓦开始逐渐降低，直到时速345公里时完全不允许使用电池。
对于拥有超车模式的车手，完整的350千瓦必须从时速337.5公里开始逐渐降低，直到时速355公里时降至零。
在大多数赛道上，这一限制并没有那么大的影响，因为赛车要么很少达到那些上限，要么能量早就耗尽了。然而，墨西哥则完全不同。
赛道的布局，终点前是体育场路段，意味着赛车在进入超长直道时能量充沛。
他们不是只在直道末端才达到速度上限并逐渐减少能量部署，而是很早就接近了速度限制。
因此，在出最后一个弯道后的很早阶段，追赶者本应最大化超车模式带来的优势，却发现自己的动力反而被削减了。
最终结果是，一旦进入限速区域，赛车之间的差距在直道很早的阶段就几乎被冻结了。
如果追赶者开始缩小与前车的速度差距，他们就会发现能量部署被自动减少了。
根据规则中规定的功率递减率，对于一辆拥有超车模式的车，在时速超过337公里后，每增加1公里/小时的速度，车手就会损失20千瓦的部署功率。
正如汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘在倒数第二圈主直道上的遥测轨迹所示，一旦他们行驶到直道中途，两人的速度差几乎不再波动。
在500米处，维斯塔潘的时速为338公里，而汉密尔顿凭借超车模式和尾流优势，时速达到349公里，因此已经在损失功率。
在900米处，两人虽然都仍处于全油门状态，但他们之间的速度差已经缩小。维斯塔潘的时速为342公里，而汉密尔顿的时速为350公里——因此他在直道上后段的追赶幅度比前段更小。
这就是汉密尔顿在赛后冷却室里向维斯塔潘抱怨的那个特性，他说：“太愚蠢了，那个削功率……我不明白为什么……就好像他们毫无常识一样。”
汉密尔顿在赛后新闻发布会上进一步解释此事时表示，从赛车竞技的角度来看，这个速度限制有点荒谬。
“我们在直道末端有这个限制，你不能超过某个速度，所以大家就只能跟着，”他说。
“当你在后面、在尾流中稍微多一点动力时，这是最愚蠢的事情。你应该能够突破那个限制，才有机会超车。”
“引擎本可以跑得更快。只是他们装上了这些愚蠢的限制装置。我的意思是，这大概是我认为这项运动有史以来最糟糕的引擎模式设定，而且它并不能带来精彩的比赛。
“所以今天你可能没看到太多超车，很不幸，就是因为这个。”
汉密尔顿并非唯一提出批评的人，诺里斯也表示，速度限制“毁了比赛”，因为追赶的车手根本没有机会超越前面的车。
“超车的主要问题就是你只能一直开着限制器，”他说，“你实际上有一个限制器，阻止你超过某个速度，所以即使你从最后一个弯出来时跟在别人后面，你也只能开着限制器，和他们一样的限制器，然后你什么都做不了。这有点毁了比赛。”
这是他们下赛季需要改进的地方。
对诺里斯和汉密尔顿来说，好消息是有关这一速度限制的规则已从2027年技术规则中删除。
即将实施的更高燃油流量和更高涡轮增压压力，再加上能量回收的额外额度，意味着赛车不会那么缺能量，因此不再需要速度限制。
在比赛中，未开启超车模式的车手只要能够维持，就被限制在300千瓦；而开启超车模式后，他们可以输出350千瓦。
在某些赛道区段，国际汽联不希望最大程度部署能量，因此仍会实施一些基于速度的限制，但这应意味着直道上的较量不再因速度限制而变得毫无意义——诺里斯曾觉得这种限制毫无道理。
F1车手们应该能够向前看，而不必担心直道上的速度限制。
正如诺里斯所说：“尤其是当摩托车能跑到370公里/小时，而你连安全带都没有的时候，我们理应能轻松跑得比摩托车更快。”
detailEn: Formula 1 drivers have got used to many quirks with the 2026 regulations, but the Mexican Grand Prix exposed one that Lewis Hamilton openly labelled “stupid”.
On a track that has historically been very difficult for cars to overtake at - because of the aero and cooling compromises caused by the thinner air - things were even harder this year.

The final laps of the race highlighted that sufficient speed offsets were simply never there, as Hamilton tried his hardest to pick up leader Max Verstappen’s tow and make a move into Turn 1, plus further back Lando Norris was aiming to do the same with Charles Leclerc.

Even with the benefit of the extra 0.5MJ of energy a driver gets for overtake mode, and a slipstream of the long run down the start-finish straight, neither Hamilton nor Norris could get close enough to make a pass stick.

The main factor holding them back was not the high-altitude venue weakening the slipstream effect in a year when the DRS advantage has disappeared for the car behind. Instead, it was the consequence of an under-the-radar 2026 rule that has effectively seen F1 operate with a speed limit.
As part of the regulations to help manage the performance profile of the energy-starved cars down the straights, the rulebook imposed a deployment limit for the end of straights.
It was supposed to help ensure an offset of power (and therefore speed) to help overtake mode, but in Mexico it proved to be more of a hindrance.
To help manage deployment usage, energy deployment gets restricted for cars without overtake mode once they hit a certain speed.
The rules are part of C5.2.8 of F1’s technical regulations and impose what is at first glance a complicated formula to limit energy deployment.
It's stated that when overtake is not active, the maximum deployment (capped at 350kW) can be 1800 minus 5 times car speed (km/h) below 340km/h.
Between 340km/h and 345km/h, the maximum deployment can be 6900 minus 20 times car speed (km/h), while anything above 345km/h must be zero.
When overtake is active, the limit is 7100 minus 20 times car speed (km/h) when the car is below 355km/h, and zero when the car speed is equal to or above 355km/h.

It sounds complicated but, as the graph above shows of the maximum power allowed, it means that for drivers without overtake mode, above 290km/h the energy deployment must start tapering down from 350kW until no battery usage is allowed at all from 345km/h.
For drivers who have overtake mode, the full 350kW has to start ramping down from 337.5 km/h until it hits zero at 355km/h.

At most tracks this limit has not been that influential because cars have either not hit those upper limits very much, or the energy has run out long before then. Mexico, however, was a different beast.
The layout of the track, with the stadium section at the end of the lap, meant cars were bursting onto the super long main straight energy-rich.
Rather than only hitting the speed limit and winding down deployment at the end of the straight, they were running near the speed limit restriction very early on.
So very early out of the final corner, rather than the pursuer being able to maximise the benefits of overtake mode, they were seeing their power reduce.
The end result was gaps between cars being pretty much frozen very early on the straight once the speed limit zone had been entered.
If the pursuer started gaining speed on the car ahead of them, they would find deployment automatically reduced.
Under the ramp-down rates declared in the rules, for every 1km/h of speed gained above 337km/h for a car with overtake, a driver lost 20kW of deployment.
As the telemetry traces of Hamilton and Verstappen down the main straight on the penultimate lap show, their speed differences barely fluctuate once they are halfway down the straight.
At 500 metres, Verstappen is doing 338km/h, while Hamilton with the benefit of overtake and a tow is doing 349km/h so already losing power.

At 900 metres, while both are still at full throttle, the speed offset between them has reduced. Verstappen is doing 342km/h while Hamilton is doing 350km/h - so he is closing less than earlier on the straight.

It was the characteristic that Hamilton bemoaned in the cooldown room after the race when he said to Verstappen: “It’s so stupid, the clipping…I don't understand why...it's like they have got no sense.”
Elaborating on the matter later on in the post-race press conference, Hamilton said the speed limit was a bit nonsensical from a racing perspective.
“We have this clip at the end of the straight where you can't go past a certain speed, so everyone just follows,” he said.
“It's the silliest thing when you are behind and you have a little bit more power in the slipstream. You should be able to go past that to have a chance to overtake.

“The engine can go faster. It's just they have these silly clips. I mean, it's the worst engine profile setting that I think they've probably ever had in this sport, and it doesn't provide great racing.
“So today you probably didn't see much overtaking, unfortunately, because of that.”
Hamilton was not alone in his criticisms, with Norris saying that the speed limit restriction “ruins racing” because pursuing cars have no chance of getting past those ahead.

“The main thing with overtaking is you just have the limiter on,” he said. “You literally have a limiter that stops you from going over a speed, so it doesn’t matter if you come out of the final corner behind the guy, you just have the limiter on, the same limiter as them, and then you cannot do anything. It kind of ruins racing.
“It’s something that they need to improve for next season.”
The good news for Norris and Hamilton is that the rules relating to this speed limit have been deleted from the 2027 regulations.
The increased fuel flow and improved turbo boost pressure that are coming, allied to extra allowance for harvesting, means cars will not be so energy-starved so the speed limit is not needed.
In races, drivers running without overtake mode are capped at 300kW for as long as they are able to hold that, while with overtake they can deploy 350kW.

Some speed-based restrictions are still in play for certain track sectors where the FIA does not want maximum deployment, but it should mean battles on the straights are no longer neutered by a speed limit that Norris felt made no sense.
And F1 drivers should be able to look forward not worrying about speed limits down the straights.
As Norris said: “Especially when motorbikes go 370 and you don’t have a seatbelt or anything, we should easily be able to go quicker than a motorbike."
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在最后几圈试图利用马克斯·维斯塔潘的尾流在一号弯发起进攻，但未能贴近到可以完成超车的距离。
兰多·诺里斯同样试图借助尾流超越夏尔·勒克莱尔，也未成功。
即便有超车模式额外0.5MJ能量和发车直道尾流的帮助，两位车手仍无法完成超车。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton tried to use Max Verstappen's tow to attack into Turn 1 in the final laps but could not get close enough to make a pass.
Lando Norris similarly tried to use the tow to pass Charles Leclerc but also failed.
Even with the extra 0.5MJ of energy from overtake mode and the slipstream on the start-finish straight, neither driver could complete a pass.

items.originalTitle: Charles Leclerc blames Mexico GP clash on track layout - Fred Vasseur disagrees
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc attributed his lap-one collision with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Mexico Grand Prix to the track layout, claiming a wall at Turn 4 would have prevented it, but Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur disagrees.
detailZh: 勒克莱尔将墨西哥大奖赛第一圈与法拉利队友汉密尔顿的碰撞归咎于赛道布局，称4号弯若有“一堵墙”就能避免。
这位法拉利车手在第一圈与队友汉密尔顿陷入轮对轮缠斗，导致法拉利错失胜利。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利。
勒克莱尔将墨西哥大奖赛第一圈与法拉利队友汉密尔顿的碰撞归咎于赛道布局，称4号弯若有“一堵墙”就能避免。
周日，在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道，法拉利车队错失了一场本应轻松到手的胜利。汉密尔顿从杆位起步，勒克莱尔排在第三，后者很快从乔治·拉塞尔手中抢到第二。
随后勒克莱尔在1号弯外侧向汉密尔顿发起进攻，希望在下个弯道的内线完成超越，但这位七届世界冠军暂时守住了位置。
他在4号弯外侧再次尝试，但两位车手都刹车过晚，导致勒克莱尔驶上草地，切过5号弯，抢到了领先位置，而马克斯·维斯塔潘则超越了汉密尔顿。
这位摩纳哥车手随后被处以五秒罚时，最终跌至第四，而愤怒的汉密尔顿以第二名完赛，仅次于维斯塔潘，基米·安东内利获得第三。
勒克莱尔表示：“整个周四的车手简报会上我们都在讨论这件事，试图弄清楚应该以何种方式做出决定。”
“我认为大家的结论是，我们首先可能需要改变赛道，确保不存在可以让你在弯道内侧冒那种风险的地方或赛道。”
“如果4号弯出口处显然有一堵墙，那么刘易斯和我都不会把刹车点推得那么晚。”
“所以我认为在赛道方面有一些可以改进的地方，使其更简单，因为否则情况会非常复杂。”
勒克莱尔指的是墨西哥站常见的起步混乱，去年维斯塔潘和其他车手在1号弯冲上草地，因此各方同意应施加更严厉的处罚。
因此，赛会干事认定，在起步以及任何重新起步时，车手将被同时视为进攻方和防守方，如果在1-3号弯和4-6号弯偏离赛道获得优势，将面临标准处罚。
勒克莱尔认为“最终的解决方案是拥有一条不允许你这样做的赛道”，法拉利领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔也多少附和了这一说法，他表示后果“在摩纳哥会更糟”。
但这位法国人不认同勒克莱尔关于墨西哥赛道特性导致他第一圈惨败的说法，而是对法拉利被剥夺2026年第三场胜利感到沮丧。
他说：“赛道的布局肯定没有帮助，因为如果你看看过去几年，我们也有这类问题，但这完全不能成为借口。”
“老实说，我有点沮丧，因为我认为在最近几场比赛中，我们在性能方面确实向前迈出了适当的一步。”
“我们在4号弯时处于1-2的位置。我不记得墨西哥上一次超车是什么时候了，也许是70年代末，而当你以1-2进入4号弯时，你不会想象自己赢不了比赛。”
“这对我来说非常沮丧，但我不是最重要的人。我认为这对为这个项目工作的2000人来说非常沮丧——这我需要时间来消化！”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc blames Mexico GP clash on track layout - Fred Vasseur disagrees
The Ferrari driver got caught up in a wheel-to-wheel battle with team-mate Lewis Hamilton on lap one, leading to the Scuderia losing victory
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Charles Leclerc blamed his lap one clash with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix on the track layout - claiming “a wall” at Turn 4 would have prevented it.
The Scuderia lost a straightforward victory at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Sunday, after Hamilton started on pole and Leclerc third, who quickly grabbed second from George Russell.
Leclerc then attacked Hamilton on the outside of Turn 1, hoping to complete the move down the inside of the following corner, but the seven-time world champion temporarily held position.
He tried again on the outside of Turn 4 but both drivers out-braked themselves, causing Leclerc to take to the grass, cut Turn 5, and grab the lead while Max Verstappen overtook Hamilton.
The Monegasque was subsequently given a five-second penalty, ultimately dropping to fourth, while a furious Hamilton finished runner-up to Verstappen with Kimi Antonelli in third.
“We've been speaking about it all Thursday at the driver’s briefing trying to understand in which way should we take a decision with that,” said Leclerc.
“I think the conclusion of everyone is that we first need, probably, to change the tracks and make sure that there's no places or tracks where you can take those amounts of risk on the inside.
“If there was, obviously, a wall at the exit of Turn 4, neither Lewis or I would have pushed the braking point that much.
“So I think there's some things that we can improve track-wise in order to make it more simple because otherwise it's very complicated.”
Leclerc was referring to the usual start chaos in Mexico, which last year saw Verstappen and others take to the grass at Turn 1, so it was agreed that stiffer penalties should be applied.

Stewards therefore deemed that at the start, and during any restarts, drivers would be considered both attacking and defending and face standard penalties if they’ve gained an advantage off-track at Turns 1-3 and 4-6.

Leclerc reckons “the final solution is to have a track that doesn’t allow you to do that” and it was somewhat echoed by Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur, who stated that the consequences “would have been worse in Monaco”.
But the Frenchman does not agree with Leclerc that the characteristics of the Mexico circuit was behind his lap one fiasco, instead being frustrated that Ferrari was denied a third win of 2026.
He said: “The layout of the track for sure, it's not helping, because if you have a look the last couple of years we had this kind of issue but it can't be an excuse at all.
“Honestly I'm a bit frustrated because I think we did a proper step forward in terms of performance the last couple of events.
“We were 1-2 at Turn 4. I don't remember the last overtaking in Mexico, perhaps at the end of the ‘70s and when you are 1-2, Turn 4, you don't imagine that you won't win the race.
“It's a lot of frustration for me but I'm not the most important. I think it's a lot of frustration for the 2,000 people working for the project - and this I will need time to digest!”

天空体育F1的马丁·布伦德尔认为，乔治·拉塞尔看到梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利成为世界冠军，内心会是“崩溃”的；圣保罗大奖赛周五的各节练习将于下午3点30分和晚上7点在天空体育F1直播。
马丁·布伦德尔认为，基米·安东内利赢得世界冠军可能激发乔治·拉塞尔进入“超常状态”，否则对这位梅赛德斯队友而言就是“一切结束”。
天空体育F1的马丁·布伦德尔认为，乔治·拉塞尔必须找到“超常状态”，以回击今年F1车手世界冠军输给基米·安东内利一事。
安东内利在周日提前四轮锁定车手总冠军，成为史上最年轻的F1世界冠军。与此同时，拉塞尔经历了又一场令人沮丧的比赛，他在开场圈遭遇电池故障，随后又因与红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔的碰撞被罚10秒，最终以第六名完赛。
拉塞尔在2025年轻松胜过安东内利后，本赛季以夺冠热门身份起步。然而，他仅取得三场胜利，而队友则有九胜，整体速度也处于下风，尽管可以说他一路走来遭遇的霉运也超出了应得的份额。

“拉塞尔会崩溃的，因为他在威廉姆斯作为梅赛德斯青训车手等了很久才得到机会。他刚得到机会，他们就停止获胜了，”布伦德尔告诉天空体育新闻。
“他们突然带着这些2026年的新车出现，一辆早期占主导地位的车，现在它并不占主导地位，但在赛季第一阶段它确实是。然后这个孩子出现了，从第一年的有点累赘转变为第二年的世代天才。
“乔治不得不观察这一点，我认为这影响了他自己的表现。他太不走运了，但安东内利也有他自己的可靠性问题，也退出了比赛。对乔治打击最大的是他无法在速度上匹配安东内利，无法在持续速度上匹配。在这个行业里，最重要的就是秒表，这是一个非常过时的系统。”
上周，乔治·拉塞尔表示，随着这位梅赛德斯车手将注意力转向明年挑战世界冠军，他希望自己能够更加稳定。
“尽管每年花费数亿美元运营F1赛车，但我们成败全凭秒表决定。乔治没有基米那么快，尤其是在使用同一套轮胎的 赛段后半段。这正是会让乔治感到困扰的地方。”
“这可能会击垮乔治，但我认为这会成就他，他会找到一种超常的驱动力，他必须做到。他必须明年回来并提升自己的水平。与此同时，他自己经历了一个糟糕的赛季。对于一个在赛季中从19岁迈入20岁的年轻人来说，这是一个出色的赛季。”
梅赛德斯免除了拉塞尔在墨西哥城大奖赛后的媒体职责，因为据车队领队托托·沃尔夫称，这位英国车手“心神俱碎”。
国际汽联因梅赛德斯车手缺席媒体职责对其处以5000欧元（4173英镑）罚款，布伦德尔表示他"不怪"拉塞尔对此的反应，拉塞尔于周一在社交媒体上发文。
安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛庆祝时佩戴了GoPro摄像机
"我们接触F1车手的机会比任何其他运动接触顶级球员的机会都要多，其他运动根本不敢想象。我认为让乔治还得去祝贺他（安东内利），这有点太过分了，"他说。
"他当然祝贺了他，是在领奖台下面，但要忍受诸如'乔治你感觉如何？这是不是你职业生涯的终点？'这样的问题，我不怪他。"
车队被罚款了，我会非常乐意支付那笔钱。不用在我最低谷的时候基本上向全世界面对现实，我觉得坦率地说这很合理。乔治要么已经超常发挥，要么就是游戏结束了。
基米·安东内利回看了一段视频集锦，记录了他从卡丁车到成为F1最年轻冠军的历程
布伦德尔：安东内利具备多次F1世界冠军的所有特质
安东内利从12岁起就是梅赛德斯车手计划的一员，在他赢得卡丁车和青训单座赛车类别冠军时引发了巨大兴奋之后，车队精心管理着他的职业生涯。
布伦德尔承认，他原本以为安东内利本赛季有时可能会“崩溃”，但看到他反而“绽放”并在摩纳哥、蒙扎和奥斯汀取得令人印象深刻的胜利，他感到很受触动。
“成为世界冠军意味着他肩上的压力将上升到全新层次，来自他的国家，也来自他即将进行的环球征战，”他说。
“如果他能应对这一点，身边有合适的人帮他分担部分压力和期望，让他的环球之旅轻松一些，他应该具备持久作战的能力。
回顾F1新加冕冠军基米·安东内利本赛季的一些最佳时刻
“他很年轻，身体也很健康。如今在F1赛车中，车手不会像过去那样经常受到严重撞击，除非真的特别倒霉。所以这在如今是一个重要因素。你不会像我们过去那样头部受到撞击，也不会像我们过去那样腿部被撞伤。”
“我确实认为安东内利具备成为多届F1冠军的所有特质。但我们拭目以待吧，正如兰多·诺里斯今年所体会到的那样，要把心理和身体方面的状态保持到第二个、第三个甚至第四个赛季，真的非常困难。”

detailEn: George Russell must find 'overdrive' in 2027 or it's 'game over' after seeing Kimi Antonelli become F1 world champion, says Martin Brundle

George Russell would have been "broken" to see his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli become world champion, according to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle; watch Friday's practice sessions for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix from 3.30pm and 7pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Martin Brundle believes Kimi Antonelli winning the world title could trigger an 'overdrive' for George Russell, or it's 'game over' for the Mercedes team-mate
Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle believes George Russell must find an "overdrive" to hit back at losing this year's Formula 1 Drivers' Championship to Kimi Antonelli.

Antonelli clinched the drivers' title with four rounds to spare on Sunday, becoming the youngest-ever F1 World Champion. Meanwhile, Russell endured another frustrating race, suffering a battery issue on the opening lap before later receiving a 10-second penalty for a collision with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar. He eventually finished sixth.

Russell started the season as the championship favourite after comfortably getting the better of Antonelli in 2025. However, he has managed just three wins compared with his team-mate's nine and has generally been outpaced, although he has arguably suffered more than his fair share of misfortune along the way.

"Russell will be broken, because he waited at Williams a long time as a Mercedes junior to get his chance. He got it just as they stopped winning," Brundle told Sky Sports News.

"They suddenly turned up with these new 2026 cars, an early dominant car, it's not dominant right now, but it was certainly in the first phase of the season. And then this kid turns up and just transforms from a bit of a liability in year one to a generational talent in year two.

"George has had to observe that, and I think it's affected his own performance. He's been so unlucky but then Antonelli had his fair share of unreliability, dropping out of races too. What will hit George hardest is that he couldn't match Antonelli for speed, for consistent speed. That's all that matters in this business, the stopwatch, it's a very antiquated system.
Last week, George Russell said he wants to be more consistent as the Mercedes driver turns his attention to challenging for the world title next year

"Despite spending hundreds of millions of dollars a year running through F1 cars, we live and die by the stopwatch. George has not been as fast as Kimi, especially in the second half of stints in a run on set of tyres. That's what will get to George.

"It might break George, but I think it'll make him, he'll find an overdrive, he has to. He has to come back next year and lift his game up. Meanwhile, he's had to suffer an awful season for himself. A brilliant season for a 19-year-old who has turned 20 through that season."
Mercedes excused Russell from carrying out his post-Mexico City Grand Prix media duties because the British driver was "distraught" according to team principal Toto Wolff.
The FIA fined Mercedes €5,000 (£4,173) for their driver's absence from his media duties and Brundle says he "doesn't blame" Russell, who posted on social media on Monday, for his reaction.
Kimi Antonelli wore a GoPro during his celebrations at the Mexico Grand Prix

"We get more access to F1 drivers than any other sport can dream of with top players, or what have you in their sports. I think it was a step too far for George to go and have to congratulate him [Antonelli]," he said.
"He did congratulate him of course, underneath the podium, but to have to put up with questions like: 'How do you feel George? And is this the end of the road for you?' I don't blame him.

"The team got fined and I'd be very happy to pay that. Not to have to basically face the music to the world when I'm at my lowest ebb and I think that's fair enough frankly. George has either got an overdrive or it's game over."
Kimi Antonelli watches back a montage of videos from his journey from go-karting, to F1's youngest champion
Brundle: Antonelli has all the hallmarks of a multiple F1 world champion

Antonelli has been part of Mercedes' driver programme since he was 12 years old and the team have carefully managed his career after a huge amount of excitement grew when he was winning championships in karting and junior single-seater categories.
Brundle admits he thought Antonelli may "fall apart" at times this season but was impressed to see him "flourish" instead with impressive victories in Monaco, Monza and Austin.
"Being a world champion is a whole new level of pressure on his shoulders, from his country, from going around the world as he will do," he said.

"If he can manage that and have the right people around him to take some of that pressure and expectation away from him and make life a bit easier with getting around the world, he should have the staying power.
A look back at some of F1's newly-crowed champion Kimi Antonelli's best moments of the season

"He's young, and he's fit. They don't get smashed up as much in F1 cars these days, unless they're super unlucky, actually. So that's a big factor these days. You don't get hit on the head like we used to. You don't get your legs smashed up like we used to.

"I do think Antonelli has all the hallmarks of a multiple F1 champion. But we'll see, it's really hard to do, as Lando Norris has found this year, to keep the mental and physical aspects of that going into two, three or even four seasons."

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥城大奖赛与查尔斯·勒克莱尔发生事件后，要求法拉利进行“严肃会谈”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在与法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔的最新一次事件让车队在墨西哥错失胜利后，重申“有些事情需要改变”；巴西周五的各节练习将于下午3点30分和晚上7点在天空体育F1直播。
马丁·布伦德尔认为，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与查尔斯·勒克莱尔在墨西哥城大奖赛期间的争执让他们错失了一二名完赛。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥城大奖赛首圈与查尔斯·勒克莱尔发生事件后，呼吁法拉利进行“严肃会谈”，而领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔则表示，给予的“尊重”不够。
勒克莱尔在4号弯外侧向汉密尔顿发起进攻，但刹车过晚，切过弯角取得领先，而汉密尔顿短暂冲出赛道后，被红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘超越。
赛会干事对勒克莱尔处以5秒罚时，这让维斯塔潘在进站阶段超越了他，随后维斯塔潘赢得比赛，汉密尔顿获得第二，勒克莱尔位列第四。
梅赛德斯如何能在本周日赢得车队总冠军

汉密尔顿表示：“最终，正是那一点让我们失去了胜利。我认为我们肯定需要在幕后进行一些严肃的讨论。”
“但好的一面是，车队非常努力。我们真的改进了赛车。这个周末我们用的还是旧引擎，所以结果不错，积分也不错。遗憾的是我们没能赢，有赢有输。”
在瓦尔特利·博塔斯驾驶凯迪拉克发生严重撞车、比赛出示红旗期间，汉密尔顿在车队无线电中表示“我们有大问题”，指的是第1圈的 incident。
重温戏剧性的首圈：在墨西哥城大奖赛上，勒克莱尔超越汉密尔顿取得领先，随后被处以五秒罚时。
沮丧的瓦塞尔表示，在本周末圣保罗大奖赛前与车手的讨论将是“关乎尊重的问题”。
当被问及是否能信任车手不会将个人目标置于车队之上时，瓦塞尔说：“这正是尊重的含义。
“他们不是为自己工作，而是为一个团队工作。他们为众多赞助商工作。他们为公司的2000名员工工作。
“伙计们，当我们不得不为升级而冲刺时，他们日夜不停地工作。我们必须记住这一点。”
汉密尔顿在开场圈被法拉利队友勒克莱尔在离开赛道的情况下超越后勃然大怒，但后者仅因违规被处以五秒罚时。
自2025年初成为法拉利队友以来，汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔已多次并肩作战。
在九月的意大利大奖赛上被勒克莱尔逼出赛道后，汉密尔顿指责法拉利“没有规则”，并要求制定“交战规则”，而他在梅赛德斯时曾拥有这些规则。
在墨西哥站的最新事件之后，他说：“我不知道现在需要发生什么，回去之后我们该如何讨论这些事情。我不太确定自己想以何种方式参与其中。”
“当然，沮丧情绪是……我很高兴，因为基米刚刚赢得了冠军，所以我真的很矛盾，因为一方面我很高兴，另一方面我真的气炸了。”
法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔回顾他们的墨西哥城大奖赛，比赛中他们在起步阶段发生了缠斗
“我们损失了宝贵的积分，而我们作为一支车队付出了巨大努力。我们本可以轻松包揽一二名。真的，我们具备做到这一点的速度。”
“我们进入4号弯时排在第一和第二。如果我们只是守住位置，比赛中什么都有可能发生，但当你的队友与你对抗，然后你就这样丢掉了位置，这确实很难受。”
“我们会在私下里谈这件事，多说也没什么意义。我们没有交战规则，至于这是否会改变查尔斯那边的做法，我不知道。我们得把这件事弄清楚，但肯定需要有所改变。”
天空体育F1的卡伦·钱多克分析墨西哥城大奖赛起步时汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔的较量
布伦德尔：汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔的事故对法拉利来说不好看
“查尔斯本应把位置还回去，但他做不到，因为狡猾的老将马克斯·维斯塔潘像今年早些时候在马德里那样，试图插到两辆法拉利之间。
“他们是天生的赛车手，我们这行很奇妙，你在团队环境中以个人身份表现。你被作为个人衡量，作为个人获得回报，但当肾上腺素飙升、出现空隙的机会时，正如伟大的艾尔顿·塞纳所说：‘如果你不去争取空隙，你就不再是赛车手了’。
观看本赛季法拉利队友汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔之间最激烈的冲突
“查尔斯今年有一些挫败感，对车队来说看起来不太好，就像兰多在新加坡冲刺赛中撞到奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里一样，对车队来说看起来不太好，你让你的车队1500人失望了。
“那只是赛车方面的问题，不涉及动力单元方面。你只是车队这条链条上的最后一环，但你就是那个必须在关键时刻拿出表现的人。法拉利总得想办法应对这一点。
“他们会坐下来谈，然后我们会去巴西，他们会说‘是的，我们坐下来谈了，我们都明白了，我们会继续前进，这种事不会再发生’，但实际上我们知道它还会再发生。”

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton demands 'serious talks' at Ferrari after Charles Leclerc incident at Mexico City Grand Prix

Lewis Hamilton reiterated "something needs to change" after his latest incident with Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc cost the Scuderia victory in Mexico; watch Friday's practice sessions in Brazil from 3.30pm and 7pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Martin Brundle feels Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc's squabbling during the Mexico City GP cost them a one-two finish

Lewis Hamilton has called for "serious talks" at Ferrari after his opening lap incident with Charles Leclerc at the Mexico City Grand Prix, while team principal Frederic Vasseur suggested there was not enough "respect" given.

Leclerc attacked Hamilton around the outside going into Turn 4 but outbraked himself and cut the corner to take the lead, while Hamilton lost out to Red Bull's Max Verstappen after briefly going off track.
The stewards gave Leclerc a five-second time penalty which allowed Verstappen to overtake him during the pit stop phase, going on to win the race while Hamilton finished second and Leclerc in fourth.

"Ultimately, it was that, that lost us the win. I think we have to have some serious talks behind the scenes, for sure," said Hamilton.

"But the good thing is the team are working really hard. We've really improved our car. We're on the old engine at the weekend as well, so good result, good points. Shame we didn't get a win, some wins, some losses."
On the team radio during a red flag period for Valtteri Bottas' big crash in his Cadillac, Hamilton stated "we've got big problems" in reference to the Lap 1 incident.
Relive a dramatic opening lap as Leclerc was given a five-second penalty after overtaking Hamilton for the lead at the Mexico City GP
A frustrated Vasseur says his discussion with the drivers ahead of this weekend's Sao Paulo Grand Prix will be "a matter of respect".
When asked if he could trust his drivers for not putting their individual objectives above the team's, Vasseur said: "This is typically what means respect.
"They are not working for themselves, they are working for a group. They are working for a lot of sponsors. They are working for the 2,000 people of the company.
"The guys, when we had to push for the upgrades, they were working night and day. We have to keep this in mind."
Hamilton was left furious after Ferrari team-mate Leclerc overtook him on the opening lap while leaving the track but was only given a five-second penalty for the infringement
Hamilton and Leclerc have found themselves fighting together several times since becoming Ferrari team-mates at the start of 2025.
After being forced wide by Leclerc at the Italian Grand Prix in September, Hamilton accused Ferrari of having "no rules" and demanded "rules of engagement" are required, which he had at Mercedes.
Following their latest incident in Mexico, he said: "I don't know what needs to happen now, how we discuss things when we go back. I'm not quite sure how I want to engage in that.
"Of course, the frustrations are.. I'm happy because Kimi just won the championship, so I'm really torn because, on one side, I'm happy, and on the other side, I'm really p*****.
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc reflect on their Mexico City GP, which saw them tussle at the start of the race
"We lost valuable points, and we, as a team, worked so hard. We could have easily had a one-two. Really, we had the pace to do so.

"We're going into Turn 4 first and second. If we just hold position, anything can happen in the race, but when your team-mate works against you and then you lose positions like that, it's definitely tough.

"We'll just talk about it offline, and it's not really worth saying too much more. We don't have rules of engagement, and whether or not that will change anything from Charles' side, I don't know. We've just got to figure it out, but something needs to change for sure."
Sky Sports F1's Karun Chandhok analyses Hamilton and Leclerc's battle at the start of the Mexico City GP
Brundle: Hamilton-Leclerc incident isn't pretty for Ferrari
"Charles should have given the place back, but he couldn't because cunning old Max Verstappen got himself in between the two Ferraris as he tried to do back in Madrid earlier this year.

"They're hard-wired racing drivers, it's a curious business we have, where you perform as an individual in a team environment. You're measured as an individual, you're rewarded as an individual, but when the adrenaline is up and the chance of a gap is there, as the great Ayrton Senna used to say: 'If you don't go for a gap, you're no longer a racing driver'.
Watch the most heated clashes between Ferrari team-mates Hamilton and Leclerc this season

"Charles has had some frustrations this year, and it doesn't look pretty for the team like when Lando ran into Oscar Piastri in Singapore in the sprint race, it doesn't look pretty for the team and you've let 1,500 people down in your team.

"That's just the car side, without the power unit side. You're only the final link in the chain of the team but you're the one out there that's got to deliver in the heat of the moment. Ferrari will have to manage that somehow.
"They will sit down and we will go to Brazil and they will say 'yes we sat down, we understood it all, we will move forward and it won't happen again' but in reality we know it will."

items.summaryEn: Footage of Lewis Hamilton greeting his former Mercedes race engineer Peter 'Bono' Bonnington at the Mexican Grand Prix went viral, drawing praise from Formula 1 fans.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿墨西哥站与前工程师彼得·邦宁顿的感人互动走红
F1车迷称赞汉密尔顿向前比赛工程师彼得·邦宁顿的真挚致意
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
七届冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛上向前梅赛德斯比赛工程师彼得·“博诺”·邦宁顿致意的视频走红后，F1车迷对此表示赞赏。
汉密尔顿在效力于布拉克利车队期间一直与邦宁顿合作，并在那里赢得了七个总冠军中的六个。在41岁的汉密尔顿于2025年离开梅赛德斯转投法拉利后，邦宁顿开始与汉密尔顿的继任者基米·安东内利合作。
这位意大利车手在F1的第二个赛季就在墨西哥大奖赛上赢得了他的首个总冠军头衔。汉密尔顿被拍到拥抱邦宁顿，祝贺他取得这一成就。
“这个周末的照片太棒了。领奖台上的三人组非常出色，”一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，指的是墨西哥大奖赛的领奖台。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道夺冠。从杆位发车的汉密尔顿和安东内利分别获得第二和第三名。
“刘易斯真是个非常有风度的人。很明显他仍然对那起事件感到非常难过，但他把这件事放在一边，去庆祝他那些值得庆祝的朋友们，”另一个人发帖说。
“说实话，汉密尔顿感觉还是更像梅赛德斯车手，只是换了身赛车服，”另一位车迷写道，还有人评论说：“博诺今天一定百感交集。为安东内利高兴，但他心里有一部分还是希望这是汉密尔顿的第八个冠军，不是吗……”
更多评论包括：“博诺本赛季也是大赢家。想象一下，你曾是有史以来最伟大的F1车手之一的工程师，然后又要回去当一名新秀的工程师。最终结果对他来说真的非常好。而且我认为，这种搭档关系正是基米能做到这一点的关键。如此年轻、初来乍到，我觉得幕后有一位经验丰富的人支持你，真的会有天壤之别。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton goes viral after emotional moment with Peter Bonnington in Mexico
Formula 1 fans have praised Lewis Hamilton for his heartfelt congratulations to former race engineer Peter Bonnington
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Formula 1 fans have praised seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton after footage of him congratulating his former Mercedes race engineer Peter 'Bono' Bonnington at the Mexican Grand Prix went viral.

Hamilton worked with Bonnington throughout his time at the Brackley outfit, where he secured six of his seven championships. After the 41-year-old left Mercedes to move to Ferrari in 2025, Bonnington started working with Hamilton's successor, Kimi Antonelli.

The Italian driver secured his maiden championship title at the Mexican Grand Prix in only his second season in F1. Hamilton was captured hugging Bonnington as he congratulated him on the achievement.

"The pictures from this weekend have been class. The podium trio was fantastic," one fan commented on Reddit, referring to the Mexican Grand Prix podium. Red Bull's Max Verstappen won at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Hamilton, who started from pole position, and Antonelli finished second and third, respectively.
"Lewis is just a very classy dude. It's obvious he's still very upset about the incident, but he's putting that aside to celebrate his friends who deserve the celebration," someone else posted.

"Hamilton still feels more like a Merc driver honestly, just in a different suit," another fan wrote, while someone else commented: "Bono must have felt bittersweet today. Happy for Antonelli but part of him did want it to be Hamilton's 8th, didn't he..."

Further comments included: "Bono has also been a big winner this season. Imagine being the engineer for perhaps the greatest F1 driver of all time, then having to go back to being the engineer for a rookie. It really turned out really well for him in the end. And I think this partnership was really what Kimi needed to pull this off. Being so young and new to the scene, I think having a seasoned head behind the scenes supporting you really makes a world of difference."
